name: FLORA
original_description: The FLORA plugin lets users generate, organize, and iterate on visual assets — hero images, moodboards, lifestyle shots, promo graphics — directly from a conversation. When used alongside other connected tools like Notion, Google Drive, or Slack, the same conversation can pull in context and write results back to where the team already works. Authentication is OAuth via your existing FLORA account.
summary_ja: 会話から画像やムードボードなどのビジュアル素材を生成・整理・改善する。
limitations_ja: 既存のFLORAアカウントによるOAuth認証を説明。他ツールとの連携はそれぞれの接続が前提。
